description: Search NLM reference sources beyond product and ingredient records: Prescribable RxNorm (the currently prescribable drug dataset), RxClass (drug classes by name or member RxCUI), MeSH (medical subject descriptors), PubMed (biomedical literature), MedlinePlus (consumer-health topic pages), MedlinePlus Genetics (condition and gene pages), MedlinePlus Connect (drug pages by name, RxCUI, or NDC), UMLS (unified medical terminology; needs UMLS_API_KEY), and ClinicalTrials.gov (study registry). One call searches exactly one source — pass `source` plus the query. Results are link-first references: a title, the stable identifier (RxCUI, class id, MeSH id, PMID, CUI, or NCT number), and a deep link to the upstream record — not extracted article or study text. Each source accepts only some query types (for example MeSH searches by name only); an invalid pairing is rejected before any request. Continue with the returned `cursor` when `hasMore` is true. No matches is a normal empty result, not an error.

cursor.description: Continuation token from a previous result's nextCursor. Only valid for the same source, type, query, and limit.

limit.description: Maximum references to return. Sources that page client-side may return slightly fewer when the upstream list ends early.

query.description: The search value: a name or term by default, or the identifier named by `type`.

response_format.description: Text format: 'markdown' for a readable reference list, or 'json' for the structured result serialized as JSON.

source.description: Which reference source to search: 'prescribable', 'rxclass', 'mesh', 'pubmed', 'medlineplus', 'medlineplus_genetics', 'medlineplus_connect', 'umls', or 'clinicaltrials'.

type.description: What the query holds: 'name' (default), 'rxcui', 'ndc', or 'cui'. Not every source accepts every type; an invalid pairing is rejected with the types that source accepts.

name: drugdata_search_references

dataset.description: Named subset of the database, e.g. 'Prescribable' for the prescribable RxNorm dataset.

publicationDate.description: Publication date as the source states it, e.g. '2020 Jan'.

id.description: Identifier of the record within the upstream database.

retrievedAt.description: When the record was fetched, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

url.description: Deep link to the record in the upstream database.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token; pass back as `cursor`.

title: Search NLM reference sources
